observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: A residential room with pink walls, a TV, and a white chalk-drawn circle on the carpet.
observation.formation_and_space: Solo dancer moving in and around a circle traced on the floor.
observation.posture: Upright torso with slight forward lean during high knee raises; soft knees.
observation.footwork: Bouncy stepping, hopping on one foot while lifting and bending the other knee high, stepping side to side and forward and back in rhythm with the music.
observation.arms_and_hands: Arms held up at chest/shoulder level with elbows bent, hands loose or holding a white cloth/handkerchief that waves or extends outward.
observation.hips_and_torso: Torso remains relatively upright with slight natural turning and swaying as the body pivots and steps around the space.
observation.levels_jumps_turns: Frequent hopping and small jumps on one foot; turning in place and traveling in a circle.
observation.costume_and_props: Beige tank top, dark skirt with a patterned hem, white leg warmers or socks, white shoes, holding a white handkerchief.
observation.cannot_infer: Exact foot-to-floor contact and weight transfer details are obscured by carpet texture and video compression.

signature_moments.what: Hopping on one foot while high-stepping and waving a white handkerchief in the air
Bouncy running steps with high knee raises while turning around
Spinning slowly while maintaining high knee lifts and arm extension with the handkerchief
